# Cerulean

> > Cerulean is a specialized job board connecting luxury professionals with career opportunities at prestigious fashion, beauty, and luxury brands worldwide.

Cerulean focuses on premium placements at iconic maisons including Chanel, Christian Dior, Hermès, Gucci, Balenciaga, and Sephora. The platform serves luxury professionals seeking positions across global fashion capitals like Paris, Singapore, and Switzerland, offering both job listings and industry reference resources.

## Key Topics

- Luxury jobs and career opportunities
- Fashion and beauty careers
- Chanel, Christian Dior, Hermès
- Gucci, Balenciaga, Sephora
- Paris and global luxury markets
- Luxury brand recruitment
- Professional luxury careers
- Language of Luxury
- Luxury industry terminology
- Fashion career resources
- Global hiring statistics
- Luxury professional development

## Core Platform

- [Cerulean – Jobs for Luxury Professionals](https://ceruleanjobs.com): Homepage for premium job placements in luxury, fashion, and beauty brands
- [Luxury Jobs — Open Positions Worldwide](https://ceruleanjobs.com/jobs): Browse luxury job listings at Chanel, Dior, Gucci, Hermès, and more
- [About Cerulean (Luxury Job Board)](https://ceruleanjobs.com/about): Information about Cerulean's luxury job board platform and mission

## Industry Resources

- [The Luxury Reference Guide](https://ceruleanjobs.com/reference): Compendium of reference resources and terminology for luxury professionals
- [Global Luxury Hiring Statistics](https://ceruleanjobs.com/stats): Hiring analytics and recruitment trends for luxury brands on Cerulean

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://ceruleanjobs.com/terms-of-service): Legal terms and conditions for using Cerulean's luxury job platform
